recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-42721 unless a later work-group decision changes URI-versus-canonical guidance for Requirements references more broadly.
issue_request: FHIR-42721 asked how a Requirements instance can reference the implementation guide or artifact it was created from. The Applied/Not Persuasive with Modification resolution rejected adding a new reference element and instead required clarifying Requirements.reference by changing Profile to profile and adding guidance that the URI should point to a specific artifact web page rather than a canonical URL, preferably a version-specific HL7 URL.
initial_application: Upstream commit a3fab5525ec95f3eddebb7c354e67954cb9f6122, titled for FHIR-42721, updated source/requirements/structuredefinition-Requirements.xml. It added the requested page-URL/version-specific-URL guidance to both Requirements.reference and Requirements.statement.reference and changed related Profile wording to profile.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists requirements=Requirements and marks Requirements normative, confirming the StructureDefinition source is in current build scope. FHIR-I minutes from 2023-09-25 record the FHIR-42721 decision as 'Will clarify the description' with an 11-0-0 vote. Searches did not find direct contrary Zulip discussion or a linked Jira issue that changes the applied interpretation.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The combined branch already contains the active source text needed for FHIR-42721, and the audit commit records that no additional reconciliation edit is required.

related_jiras.note: Mentioned on the same FHIR-I minutes page as a separate Requirements satisfaction/reference clarification, but it concerns a different element and was not needed to decide FHIR-42721.
